name: Apple Retail Indonesia - Synthetic Data Science Case Study
price_reference_type: advertised retailer catalog/starting price anchor; not actual historical realized sales prices
sale_data_type: fully synthetic; not Apple/Digimap actual transactions
store_data_type: fictional store network (city/province are real places)
notes: Calendar-based campaign and store opening dates are synthetic assumptions.
Dates for iPhone 16 and 17 availability are sourced from Apple Indonesia; most others conservatively simulated.
Sourced October 2026 catalog prices should NOT be interpreted as actual 2024 or 2025 market prices.
Customer data and store identities are deliberately not copied from real people/retail chains.
